cases.note: The RPU maps identically: it signals 8.2 without a real SDR-to-HDR grade.

cases.title: Dolby Vision profile 7 (dual layer, MEL), 1080p
cases.note: A UHD Blu-ray's layout: an HDR10 base layer, a quarter-size enhancement layer, and dovi_tool's MIT-licensed profile 7 test RPU on every frame. HLS has no profile 7, so its master names only the base.
